_comment: FICTIONAL companies for testing the pipeline. Names, people and notes are invented; .example domains never resolve. stage values are the labels from crm/twenty_common.py STAGES.

companies.name: Quillory
companies.one_liner: Accounts payable automation for mid-market finance teams
companies.notes: Seed round: raising 2M EUR, lead not yet named. Founders: CEO ex finance operations lead at a logistics group (9y); CTO ex staff engineer at a payments company. KPIs: ARR 410k EUR (Jun), 2.8x YoY; 38 paying customers; logo churn 1 in 12 months; NRR 112%. Moat: supplier network data from processed invoices, ERP integrations. Market: EU mid-market AP spend is fragmented, e-invoicing mandates as tailwind. Risk: crowded category, possible overlap with portfolio company Sample Ledger Co.

companies.name: Kelpforge
companies.one_liner: Carbon accounting API for logistics platforms
companies.notes: Pre-seed: raising 900k EUR on a SAFE. Founders: CEO ex product lead at a freight marketplace; CTO ex data engineer at an energy utility. KPIs: 6 design partners, 2 paid pilots at 18k EUR each, API calls 1.4M/month. Moat: emissions factor dataset curated per transport lane. Market: reporting regulation pushes shippers to measure scope 3. Risk: pricing power unproven.

companies.name: Tessaloop
companies.notes: Seed: raising 3M EUR, 1M committed from angels. Founders: CEO second-time founder (previous company acquired); CTO ex billing platform engineer. KPIs: ARR 260k EUR, 14 customers, gross margin 81%. Moat: metering SDKs embedded in customer code. Market: shift from seats to usage pricing. Risk: long sales cycles with larger accounts.
